context7._comment_1: Up-to-date library documentation (Flutter, Firebase, Riverpod, freezed). Free tier, no API key.
context7._comment_2: Prevents the agent hallucinating outdated APIs. Trigger by saying 'use context7' or let agent auto-call.

github._comment_1: GitHub official MCP server — issues, PRs, repos, code search, workflows.
github._comment_2: Two install options. Pick ONE per dev based on what's available locally.
github._comment_3: OPTION A (recommended for team) — remote hosted by GitHub, requires Cursor v0.48.0+:
github._comment_4: OPTION B (below — active by default) — local Docker container. Requires Docker Desktop running.

figma-mcp-go._comment_1: Figma MCP via plugin bridge (vkhanhqui/figma-mcp-go) — NO Figma API token, NO rate limits.
figma-mcp-go._comment_2: 73 tools: read + write + create frames/components/variables/styles, export, prototype reactions.
figma-mcp-go._comment_3: Why this over figma-developer-mcp: free plan only allows 6 tool calls/month via REST API. This bridges through a Figma plugin instead → unlimited.
figma-mcp-go._comment_4: ONE-TIME SETUP — install Figma plugin: download plugin.zip from https://github.com/vkhanhqui/figma-mcp-go/releases → Figma Desktop → Plugins → Development → Import plugin from manifest → select manifest.json. Run plugin in any Figma file before asking the agent to use it.
